413-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
413-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Blasting Station triggers, and Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the first Olag and Miau trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second Olag and Miau trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.
413-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

240-4742-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

1432-2645-3430-5621.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3430-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

236-822-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
236-822-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
236-822-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

3755-4460-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-5671-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-5671-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1052-3899-6553.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

275-4030-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Starnheim Courser.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

2511-3192-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
2511-3192-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4499-6259-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
4499-6259-7494.notes: Your speed must be at least two for this combo to add infinite mana.

465-3742-4251-4875-7297.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1734-2150-2921.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3088-3129-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1251-1329-1482.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1350-2793-5411-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

147-2438-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-2438-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

252-2034-5394.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat.

1336-4824-6287.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness and has power 6 or greater.
Soliton and Heronblade Elite are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
1336-4824-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Heronblade Elite.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Soliton.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3951-5256-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-5256-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1437-6015.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-6015.description:
Cast Gitaxian Anatomist by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Gitaxian Anatomist spell three times.
Resolve the first Gitaxian Anatomist spell.
When the Gitaxian Anatomist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to tap it and put an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-6015.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Gitaxian Anatomist spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

2060-2874-4613.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has power 5 or greater and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2060-2874-4613.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler using Heroes' Bane's ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler equal to its power.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

220-428-1946-3908.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Nomads en-Kor indestructible.
You have a way to target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
220-428-1946-3908.description:
Give Nomads en-Kor indestructible, if needed, and then target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Repeat step 2 until only 1 damage will be dealt to Nomads en-Kor.
Resolve the spell or ability, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and any remaining damage to Brash Taunter.
Ghyrson Starn and Spark Double trigger for the damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, along with Brash Taunter. Ghyrson Starn and Spark Double also trigger for the damage dealt to Brash Taunter if exactly 1 damage  was dealt to it.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing at least 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve both Spark Double triggers, dealing 2 damage to Nomads en-Kor, and 2 damage to Brash Taunter, if applicable.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, if applicable, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and 1 damage to Brash Taunter.
Spark Double triggers twice, and Brash Taunter triggers once.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger from step 13, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor in step 13, dealing 1 damage to Brash Taunter and 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor.
Repeat from step 13 one additional time, with the nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggering instead of Spark Double.
Repeat from step 13.

2060-2816-4929-5622.notablePrerequisites:
Shaile does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Shaile.
2060-2816-4929-5622.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}.
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {2}.
Activate Shaile by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler, Cryptic Trilobite and any other creature that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Shaile by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

369-1258-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Abduction triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

776-2825-3271.notablePrerequisites:
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
776-2825-3271.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {0} and tapping it, casting a copy of Evermind without paying its mana cost.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Evermind, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

678-710-876-4050-4445.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Danitha.
Activate Danitha by tapping it, adding {4}{W} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding one mana of any color.
When Danitha dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Danitha to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Danitha by paying {4}{W}.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Leyline Immersion onto the battlefield from your graveyard attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

1283-3598-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Rapacious One.
1283-3598-3750.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Rapacious One.
Rapacious One triggers, creating five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate the five Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing them, adding {5}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

417-4992.description:
Gravity Sphere causes all creatures to lose flying.
Stormtide Leviathan prevents creatures from attacking unless they have flying and/or islandwalk. Since no creatures will have flying, only creatures with islandwalk can attack.
